objective: Make holyagent repair every visual review finding that affects what renders, and re-inspect, without asking the user, so rendered work only reaches the user once the inspection is clean.
scope: User (verbatim): 'ele terminou, viu problemas e não concertou automaticamente. é esse o ponto de revisão visual, arrumar automaticamente. resolva no holyagent'. Case: the session 'Obsidian 3 prediction artifact' published a page; Reviewer.visual passed the blocking criteria and listed three small findings (cramped line labels in a chart, effort labels disappearing at 400px width, a 'All 24 models' title over a 25-row table); the root reported them and asked 'Se quiser, corrijo esses três' instead of repairing.

Rules to state (requirements.md first, then the claude-5.5 root visual and assignments sections, and the Reviewer.visual and Worker.visual role text): every visual finding about legibility, overlap or cramped text, responsiveness at any listed viewport, text or numbers that misstate the content, accessibility, or interaction is a repair, not an optional note, whatever severity the reviewer gave it; the root dispatches the repair and the re-inspection of only what it touched, and repeats until the inspection is clean, without asking; only pure taste with none of those effects is skipped, and it is named in the final report, not offered as a question. Reviewer.visual marks such findings blocking. The final report never offers fixes the root can make itself.
Follow the Writing instructions rules in packages/integrations/claude/dist/agents/holyagent.md (calm, the reason beside each rule, no larger than needed); mind the root-core budget test.
constraints: Work only in that worktree; run bun install --frozen-lockfile if node_modules is missing; make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/. Edit only packages/runtime/src/instructions: do not rebuild dist or edit tests (another writer owns those paths now). Run mise run verify and report which failures, if any, come only from the stale generated dist; name any test that needs updating.
When done and checked, stop and report; no unrequested changes.

criteria.text: The instruction text makes the root repair and re-inspect every visual finding with a legibility, responsiveness, accuracy, accessibility or interaction effect without asking, in requirements.md, the root sections and the visual role texts
mise run verify shows no failures other than the stale generated dist, and any needed test change is named
